title: Three-dimensional simple real Bol algebras
summary: In this paper, we provide a complete classification of real three-dimensional simple Bol algebras $(B, [.,.], \langle .,.,. \rangle )$. The main part of the classification concerns the case $[B,B]=B$. In addition, we identify two isomorphism classes with a nonzero binary product, both satisfying $\dim[B,B]=2$, as well as four simple classes of Lie triple systems in which the binary product vanishes.
